title: Error when building with `disable_3d`
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in current master b377562b52fa8a68a99d5e818d8e08ac8d3fd7da

### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description

I’m getting some errors when building with the following command: `scons platform=android target=template_debug arch=arm64 disable_3d=yes`

### Steps to reproduce

1. Clone master b377562b52fa8a68a99d5e818d8e08ac8d3fd7da
2. Build with `scons platform=android target=template_debug arch=arm64 disable_3d=yes`
3. Wait for it to throw errors.
